identificationModule.briefTitle: Peginterferon α-2b Injection for Hydroxyurea Resistant or Intolerant ET
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetic, Safety and Efficacy of Peginterferon Alfa-2b Injection in Subjects With Essential Thrombocythemia Who Are Resistant to or Intolerant of Hydroxyurea.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, randomized, open-label Phase 2 clinical study. It is aimed to enroll 27 essential thrombocytopenia (ET) patients who are resistant to or intolerant of hydroxyurea(HU). Eligible patients will be randomized to receive either Peginterferon α-2b 135 mcg or Peginterferon α-2b 180 mcg at a ratio of 1:2, and all subjects will go through a target treatment period (Weeks 1 \~ Week 48), an extension treatment period (Weeks 49 \~ Week 96) and a follow-up period (Weeks 97 \~ Week 100). Pharmacokinetics, safety, efficacy will be evaluated.

interventions.name: Peginterferon α-2b injection
interventions.description: Peginterferon α-2b injection, 135 mcg, s.c., once a week, during the targeted treatment period (the first 48 week), peginterferon α-2b dose is depended on the patient's response and tolerability during the extension treatment (week 49 to week 96).

interventions.name: Peginterferon α-2b injection
interventions.description: Peginterferon α-2b injection, 180 mcg, s.c., once a week, during the targeted treatment period (the first 48 week), peginterferon α-2b dose is depended on the patient's response and tolerability during the extension treatment (week 49 to week 96).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Area under the plasma concentration-time curve
Apparent volume of distribution after oral administration (Vz/f)
Relationship between exposure and the effect (desired-effectiveness or undesirable-toxicity) in a pharmacokinetic model and pharmacodynamic model.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: White blood cell counts change from baseline.
Time to complete remission from baseline.
Change of JAK2V617F mutations load from baseline.
secondaryOutcomes.description: JAK2V617F mutations were quantitatively detected using next-generation sequencing

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change of CALR mutations load from baseline.
secondaryOutcomes.description: CALR mutations were quantitatively detected using next-generation sequencing

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change of MPL mutations load from baseline.
secondaryOutcomes.description: MPL mutations were quantitatively detected using next-generation sequencing

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change of MPN-SAF TSS scores from baseline
Change of spleen size from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: The maximum length of the spleen was measured by ultrasound.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of complete hematological remission maintenance in patients received dose-reduction extension therapy
Duration of complete hematological remission in patients received dose-reduction extension therapy
Change of 3-level Version of EuroQol Five Dimensions(EQ-5D-3L) scores from baseline.
Incidence of thrombotic and bleeding events.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year
